q24318.en: There are penalties for anyone who, while using the seat belt, alters or blocks its normal working.

explain.short: A belt that is altered or blocked does not protect you. Wearing it is not enough: it must work normally.
explain.rule: Seat belts must be of an approved type (omologato) and always kept in good working order. Check them for wear. Never alter the belt, its reel or its warning light.
explain.trap: 'pur facendo uso' means 'even while using it': wearing a belt that does not work properly is still punished.

sceneParams.caption: Belt worn but tampered with: you get a fine

q24319.en: If you do not fasten your seat belt, in sudden braking you can be thrown against the windscreen.

explain.short: Without a belt your body keeps moving forward when the car stops suddenly. You can hit the windscreen.
explain.rule: A seat belt keeps your body on the seat in a crash: you do not hit the inside of the car and you are not thrown out. It works only if worn correctly and nobody alters it.
explain.trap: 'proiettati' means 'thrown': even a sudden brake, not only a crash, can throw you forward.

sceneParams.caption: No belt: sudden braking throws you forward

q24320.en: If the vehicle has front and side airbags, you can do without fastening the seat belt.

explain.short: Airbags only help together with the belt. Without the belt an airbag can even hurt you, so the belt stays compulsory.
explain.rule: Seat belts (cinture di sicurezza) are compulsory for the driver and ALL passengers, front and rear, in every driving situation: in town, at low speed, on short trips. Airbags do not replace them.
explain.trap: 'si può fare a meno' means 'you can do without': no amount of airbags removes the duty to wear the belt.

sceneParams.caption: Airbags never replace the seat belt

q24321.en: Seat belts must be fastened only if you drive at 30 km/h or faster.

explain.short: Belts are compulsory at every speed. Even a crash at low speed can cause serious injuries.
explain.rule: Seat belts (cinture di sicurezza) are compulsory for the driver and ALL passengers, front and rear, in every driving situation: in town, at low speed, on short trips. Airbags do not replace them.
explain.trap: 'solo' (only) is the trap: there is no minimum speed for the belt.

sceneParams.caption: Belt at every speed, not only from 30 km/h

keywords.en: speed equal to or higher than

q24322.en: In vehicles with an airbag that has a switch-off control, before placing a child seat on the front seat (backrest towards the windscreen), you must switch off the airbag.

explain.short: A rear-facing child seat sits right in front of the airbag. If the airbag opens it hits the seat hard and can badly hurt the child.
explain.rule: A child seat facing backwards (back towards the windscreen) may go in the front seat ONLY if the passenger airbag is switched off. No switch to turn it off: never put that seat in the front.
explain.trap: 'schienale rivolto verso il parabrezza' means the seat faces backwards: this is the case where the airbag must be off.

sceneParams.caption: Rear-facing seat in front: airbag OFF first

q24323.en: In vehicles without a control to switch off the passenger-side airbag, the child seat must not be placed on the front seat with its backrest facing the road.

explain.short: If the airbag cannot be switched off, it would hit a rear-facing child seat in a crash. So that seat must go in the back.
explain.rule: A child seat facing backwards (back towards the windscreen) may go in the front seat ONLY if the passenger airbag is switched off. No switch to turn it off: never put that seat in the front.
explain.trap: 'schienale rivolto verso la strada' means the seat faces backwards (its back is towards the road ahead).

sceneParams.caption: No airbag switch: rear-facing seat never in front
lines: Not allowed: put it in the back

q24325.en: If a vehicle has an airbag, there is no obligation to wear seat belts while driving.

explain.short: The airbag is designed to work together with the belt. The belt is always compulsory, airbag or not.
explain.rule: Seat belts (cinture di sicurezza) are compulsory for the driver and ALL passengers, front and rear, in every driving situation: in town, at low speed, on short trips. Airbags do not replace them.
explain.trap: 'non vi è l'obbligo' (there is no obligation) is wrong: the airbag never cancels the belt duty.

sceneParams.caption: Airbag or not, the belt is compulsory

q24326.en: The headrest is useful to prevent "whiplash".

explain.short: In a crash from behind, the head snaps backwards. The headrest stops it and protects the neck.
explain.rule: The headrest (poggiatesta) is a safety device: it stops the head from snapping backwards in a crash (whiplash). It must be adjusted in height and tilt.
explain.trap: 'colpo di frusta' means 'whiplash', a neck injury when the head is thrown back and forth.

sceneParams.caption: The headrest protects the neck from whiplash

q24327.en: The headrest is useful if it is adjusted correctly, both in height and in tilt.

explain.short: A headrest set too low or too far back cannot stop the head. It must be at the right height and close to the head.
explain.rule: The headrest (poggiatesta) is a safety device: it stops the head from snapping backwards in a crash (whiplash). It must be adjusted in height and tilt.
explain.trap: 'sia in altezza che in inclinazione' means 'both height and tilt': both adjustments matter.

sceneParams.caption: Adjust the headrest height and tilt
lines: Top of headrest at head level
Close to the back of the head

q24328.en: The headrest is especially useful for relaxing your muscles while driving.

explain.short: The headrest is not for comfort or rest. It is a safety device against whiplash in a crash.
explain.rule: The headrest (poggiatesta) is a safety device: it stops the head from snapping backwards in a crash (whiplash). It must be adjusted in height and tilt.
explain.trap: 'rilassare la muscolatura' (relax the muscles) is the wrong purpose: it is for safety, not comfort.

sceneParams.caption: Headrest = safety in a crash, not relaxing

q24329.en: The headrest has an aesthetic function, not a safety function.

explain.short: The opposite is true. The headrest is a safety device that protects the neck in a crash.
explain.rule: The headrest (poggiatesta) is a safety device: it stops the head from snapping backwards in a crash (whiplash). It must be adjusted in height and tilt.
explain.trap: 'estetica' means 'for looks': the headrest is a safety device, not decoration.

sceneParams.caption: The headrest is a safety device, not decoration

q24330.en: Pregnant women with particular certified risk conditions are not required to fasten the seat belt.

explain.short: The law exempts a pregnant woman only if a doctor certifies a particular risk. Without that certificate she must wear the belt.
explain.rule: Only a few people need not wear a belt: pregnant women with a certified risk, people with a certified illness, driving instructors while teaching, and some emergency and police crews on duty. Age, a learner permit or a job like postman is NOT an exemption.
explain.trap: 'con particolari condizioni di rischio certificate' is the key: the exemption needs a medical certificate.

sceneParams.caption: Certified risky pregnancy: belt exemption

q24331.en: People who suffer from particular certified illnesses are not required to fasten the seat belt.

explain.short: A person with a medical certificate for a particular illness may travel without a belt. They must carry the certificate.
explain.rule: Only a few people need not wear a belt: pregnant women with a certified risk, people with a certified illness, driving instructors while teaching, and some emergency and police crews on duty. Age, a learner permit or a job like postman is NOT an exemption.
explain.trap: 'certificate' is the key word: the illness must be certified by a doctor.

sceneParams.caption: Certified illness: belt exemption

q24332.en: Driving instructors, while doing their job, are not required to fasten the seat belt.

explain.short: An instructor may need to move quickly to the dual controls or the wheel. So the law exempts them during lessons.
explain.rule: Only a few people need not wear a belt: pregnant women with a certified risk, people with a certified illness, driving instructors while teaching, and some emergency and police crews on duty. Age, a learner permit or a job like postman is NOT an exemption.
explain.trap: 'nello svolgimento della loro professione' means 'while working': the exemption is only during lessons.

sceneParams.caption: Driving instructor during a lesson: exempt
lines: Instructor may need to act fast

q24333.en: The postman, while at work, does not have to fasten the seat belt.

explain.short: Postmen are not on the list of exemptions. Like any driver, they must wear the belt.
explain.rule: Only a few people need not wear a belt: pregnant women with a certified risk, people with a certified illness, driving instructors while teaching, and some emergency and police crews on duty. Age, a learner permit or a job like postman is NOT an exemption.
explain.trap: 'postino' (postman) is a trap: frequent stops for work do not create an exemption.

sceneParams.caption: Postman: no exemption, belt compulsory

q24334.en: People over 65 years of age are not required to fasten the seat belt.

explain.short: Age gives no exemption. Older people must wear the belt like everyone else.
explain.rule: Only a few people need not wear a belt: pregnant women with a certified risk, people with a certified illness, driving instructors while teaching, and some emergency and police crews on duty. Age, a learner permit or a job like postman is NOT an exemption.
explain.trap: 'oltre 65 anni' (over 65 years): age is never a reason to skip the belt.

sceneParams.caption: Over 65: belt still compulsory
lines: Not allowed: age is no excuse

q24335.en: Someone who drives a car with a learner permit (foglio rosa) is not required to use the seat belt.

explain.short: The learner driver must wear the belt like any driver. Only the instructor during a lesson is exempt.
explain.rule: Only a few people need not wear a belt: pregnant women with a certified risk, people with a certified illness, driving instructors while teaching, and some emergency and police crews on duty. Age, a learner permit or a job like postman is NOT an exemption.
explain.trap: 'foglio rosa' (learner permit) is a trap: the learner is not exempt, only the instructor is.

sceneParams.caption: Learner driver: belt compulsory

q24336.en: The helmet is compulsory for drivers of two-wheeled mopeds.

explain.short: Every moped rider must wear an approved helmet, fastened. This is true at any age.
explain.rule: The helmet (casco) is compulsory for the driver and the passenger of mopeds and motorcycles, at any age and with any licence. Only motorcycles with a safety cell and restraint systems are exempt.
explain.trap: 'ciclomotori' means 'mopeds' (small motorbikes up to 50 cc): helmet compulsory too.

sceneParams.caption: Moped rider: helmet compulsory

q24337.en: The helmet is compulsory for drivers of motorcycles not fitted with a safety cell and restraint devices.

explain.short: Normal motorcycles have no safety cell, so the rider must wear a helmet. Only special motorcycles with a cell and belts are exempt.
explain.rule: The helmet (casco) is compulsory for the driver and the passenger of mopeds and motorcycles, at any age and with any licence. Only motorcycles with a safety cell and restraint systems are exempt.
explain.trap: 'non dotati di cellula di sicurezza' means 'without a safety cell': that is almost every motorcycle, so the helmet is compulsory.

sceneParams.caption: Normal motorcycle: helmet compulsory

q24338.en: The helmet is compulsory for the passenger of a motorcycle without a safety cell and restraint systems.

explain.short: The passenger is as exposed as the rider. On a normal motorcycle both must wear a helmet.
explain.rule: The helmet (casco) is compulsory for the driver and the passenger of mopeds and motorcycles, at any age and with any licence. Only motorcycles with a safety cell and restraint systems are exempt.
explain.trap: 'passeggero' (passenger): the helmet rule covers the passenger too, not only the driver.

sceneParams.caption: Motorcycle passenger: helmet compulsory

q24339.en: The helmet is compulsory for the passenger of a two-wheeled moped, even if an adult.

explain.short: Age does not matter. An adult passenger on a moped must wear a helmet like a minor.
explain.rule: The helmet (casco) is compulsory for the driver and the passenger of mopeds and motorcycles, at any age and with any licence. Only motorcycles with a safety cell and restraint systems are exempt.
explain.trap: 'anche se maggiorenne' means 'even if 18 or older': adults are not exempt.

sceneParams.caption: Moped passenger, adult too: helmet

q24340.en: The helmet is compulsory for drivers of two-wheeled mopeds only if they are minors.

explain.short: The helmet is compulsory for every moped rider, adult or minor. Age makes no difference.
explain.rule: The helmet (casco) is compulsory for the driver and the passenger of mopeds and motorcycles, at any age and with any licence. Only motorcycles with a safety cell and restraint systems are exempt.
explain.trap: 'solo se minorenni' (only if under 18) is the trap: adults must wear it too.

sceneParams.caption: Helmet for all moped riders, not only minors

q24341.en: The helmet is not compulsory for drivers of two-wheeled mopeds who hold a category B licence.

explain.short: A car licence changes nothing. Anyone riding a moped must wear a helmet.
explain.rule: The helmet (casco) is compulsory for the driver and the passenger of mopeds and motorcycles, at any age and with any licence. Only motorcycles with a safety cell and restraint systems are exempt.
explain.trap: 'titolari di patente della categoria B' (holders of a car licence): a licence never removes the helmet duty.

sceneParams.caption: Car licence or not, moped riders wear a helmet

q24342.en: The helmet is not compulsory for drivers of two-wheeled mopeds.

explain.short: The helmet is compulsory on mopeds as on motorcycles. Every rider must wear one.
explain.rule: The helmet (casco) is compulsory for the driver and the passenger of mopeds and motorcycles, at any age and with any licence. Only motorcycles with a safety cell and restraint systems are exempt.
explain.trap: 'non è obbligatorio' (is not compulsory) is wrong: on a moped the helmet is always compulsory.

sceneParams.caption: Mopeds too: helmet compulsory

q24343.en: Seat belts are meant to limit injuries to the driver and passengers in a road accident.

explain.short: In a crash the belt holds you in place. You suffer much less harm.
explain.rule: A seat belt keeps your body on the seat in a crash: you do not hit the inside of the car and you are not thrown out. It works only if worn correctly and nobody alters it.
explain.trap: 'limitare i danni' means 'limit the injuries': belts reduce harm, they do not prevent crashes.

sceneParams.caption: Belts reduce injuries in a crash

q24344.en: Seat belts must be worn by both the driver and the passengers of cars that have them.

explain.short: The belt rule covers everyone in the car, not only the driver.
explain.rule: Seat belts (cinture di sicurezza) are compulsory for the driver and ALL passengers, front and rear, in every driving situation: in town, at low speed, on short trips. Airbags do not replace them.
explain.trap: 'sia dal conducente che dai passeggeri' means 'both driver and passengers': nobody is left out.

sceneParams.caption: Driver and all passengers wear belts

q24345.en: Seat belts need periodic checks of their wear and efficiency.

explain.short: A worn or damaged belt can break in a crash. Check it from time to time.
explain.rule: Seat belts must be of an approved type (omologato) and always kept in good working order. Check them for wear. Never alter the belt, its reel or its warning light.
explain.trap: 'periodico controllo' means 'regular check': belts wear out and must be inspected.

sceneParams.caption: Check your belts for wear regularly

q24346.en: Seat belts must be of an approved type and must always be kept in working order.

explain.short: Only approved belts are tested to hold in a crash. They must always work properly.
explain.rule: Seat belts must be of an approved type (omologato) and always kept in good working order. Check them for wear. Never alter the belt, its reel or its warning light.
explain.trap: 'omologato' means 'officially approved': homemade or unapproved belts are not allowed.

sceneParams.caption: Belts: approved type, always working

q24347.en: Seat belts are meant to keep the body attached to the seat in a violent impact.

explain.short: In a violent crash the body wants to fly forward. The belt keeps it on the seat.
explain.rule: A seat belt keeps your body on the seat in a crash: you do not hit the inside of the car and you are not thrown out. It works only if worn correctly and nobody alters it.
explain.trap: 'attaccato al sedile' means 'held to the seat': that is the main job of the belt.

sceneParams.caption: The belt keeps you on the seat in a crash
lines: Belt holds you to the seat

keywords.it: mantenere il corpo attaccato al sedile
keywords.en: keep the body attached to the seat

q24348.en: Seat belts are meant to stop the driver or passengers from hitting parts inside the vehicle in a violent impact.

explain.short: Without a belt you hit the wheel, dashboard or windscreen. The belt stops this.
explain.rule: A seat belt keeps your body on the seat in a crash: you do not hit the inside of the car and you are not thrown out. It works only if worn correctly and nobody alters it.
explain.trap: 'parti interne del veicolo' means 'inside parts of the vehicle' like the wheel and dashboard.

sceneParams.caption: Belt stops you hitting the wheel and dashboard
lines: No hit on wheel or dashboard

keywords.en: hit inside parts of the vehicle

q24349.en: Seat belts are meant to stop the driver or passengers from being thrown out of the car in a violent impact.

explain.short: In a crash, people without a belt can be thrown out of the car. This is often deadly.
explain.rule: A seat belt keeps your body on the seat in a crash: you do not hit the inside of the car and you are not thrown out. It works only if worn correctly and nobody alters it.
explain.trap: 'proiettati all'esterno' means 'thrown outside': the belt keeps you inside the car.

sceneParams.caption: Belt keeps you inside the car
lines: Not thrown out of the car

q24350.en: Seat belts must be used in every driving situation.

explain.short: There is no situation where you may drive without the belt (except the certified exemptions).
explain.rule: Seat belts (cinture di sicurezza) are compulsory for the driver and ALL passengers, front and rear, in every driving situation: in town, at low speed, on short trips. Airbags do not replace them.
explain.trap: 'qualsiasi situazione' means 'any situation': town, short trips, low speed, all included.

sceneParams.caption: Belt in every driving situation

q24351.en: Seat belts must also be used by passengers in the rear seats of cars.

explain.short: Rear passengers must wear the belt too. Unbelted, they can also hurt the people in front.
explain.rule: Seat belts (cinture di sicurezza) are compulsory for the driver and ALL passengers, front and rear, in every driving situation: in town, at low speed, on short trips. Airbags do not replace them.
explain.trap: 'anche dai passeggeri dei sedili posteriori' means 'rear passengers too': the back seat is not exempt.

sceneParams.caption: Rear passengers wear belts too

q24352.en: Seat belts must be of an approved type and always kept in working order.

explain.short: Only approved belts are tested to hold in a crash. They must always work properly.
explain.rule: Seat belts must be of an approved type (omologato) and always kept in good working order. Check them for wear. Never alter the belt, its reel or its warning light.
explain.trap: 'omologato' means 'officially approved'; 'efficienti' means 'in working order'.

sceneParams.caption: Belts: approved type, always working

q24353.en: It is not compulsory to use seat belts in a car when driving at less than 30 km/h.

explain.short: Belts are compulsory at any speed. A crash at low speed can still injure you.
explain.rule: Seat belts (cinture di sicurezza) are compulsory for the driver and ALL passengers, front and rear, in every driving situation: in town, at low speed, on short trips. Airbags do not replace them.
explain.trap: 'inferiore ai 30 km/h' (under 30 km/h): there is no speed below which belts are optional.

sceneParams.caption: Belt at every speed, even below 30 km/h
lines: Not allowed: belt at any speed

q24354.en: It is not compulsory, but it is recommended, to wear seat belts if you sit in the rear seats of a car.

explain.short: Rear seat belts are compulsory, not just a good idea. Every passenger must wear one.
explain.rule: Seat belts (cinture di sicurezza) are compulsory for the driver and ALL passengers, front and rear, in every driving situation: in town, at low speed, on short trips. Airbags do not replace them.
explain.trap: 'non è obbligatorio, ma è consigliato' (not compulsory, just advised) is wrong: it IS compulsory.

sceneParams.caption: Rear seats: belt compulsory, not just advised

q24355.en: Elderly people (over 70 years old) are not required to use seat belts in a car.

explain.short: Age gives no exemption. Older people must wear the belt like everyone else.
explain.rule: Only a few people need not wear a belt: pregnant women with a certified risk, people with a certified illness, driving instructors while teaching, and some emergency and police crews on duty. Age, a learner permit or a job like postman is NOT an exemption.
explain.trap: 'età superiore ai 70 anni' (over 70): age is never an exemption.

sceneParams.caption: Over 70: belt still compulsory
lines: Not allowed: age is no excuse

q24356.en: It is not compulsory to use seat belts in vehicles fitted with airbags.

explain.short: The airbag works together with the belt, not instead of it. The belt is always compulsory.
explain.rule: Seat belts (cinture di sicurezza) are compulsory for the driver and ALL passengers, front and rear, in every driving situation: in town, at low speed, on short trips. Airbags do not replace them.
explain.trap: 'muniti di air-bag' (fitted with airbags): an airbag never replaces the belt.

sceneParams.caption: Airbag or not, the belt is compulsory

q24357.en: The light that shows a belt is not fastened can be switched off by the driver with a special control on the dashboard.

explain.short: The belt warning light reminds you to buckle up. There is no dashboard switch to turn it off, and you must not disable it.
explain.rule: Seat belts must be of an approved type (omologato) and always kept in good working order. Check them for wear. Never alter the belt, its reel or its warning light.
explain.trap: 'può essere disabilitata dal conducente' (can be switched off by the driver) is wrong.

sceneParams.caption: The belt warning light can't be switched off
lines: No switch to turn it off

q24358.en: Obese people may use special devices that stop the seat belt from fitting close to the body.

explain.short: A loose belt does not hold you in a crash. Devices that keep it off the body are not allowed for anyone.
explain.rule: Seat belts must be of an approved type (omologato) and always kept in good working order. Check them for wear. Never alter the belt, its reel or its warning light.
explain.trap: 'evitano che la cintura stia aderente' (stop it fitting close) is wrong: the belt must fit close.

sceneParams.caption: A belt must fit close to the body, for everyone

q24359.en: The seat belt reel can be switched off or changed by the driver if it bothers the passenger.

explain.short: The reel (arrotolatore) locks the belt in a crash. Changing it stops the belt from working, so it is forbidden.
explain.rule: Seat belts must be of an approved type (omologato) and always kept in good working order. Check them for wear. Never alter the belt, its reel or its warning light.
explain.trap: 'se crea fastidio' (if it bothers someone) is not a reason: you must never alter the belt.

sceneParams.caption: Never alter the belt reel
lines: Belt reel locks in a crash

q24360.en: Seat belts are of little use in town traffic.

explain.short: Many crashes happen in town. Even at town speeds a belt can save your life.
explain.rule: Seat belts (cinture di sicurezza) are compulsory for the driver and ALL passengers, front and rear, in every driving situation: in town, at low speed, on short trips. Airbags do not replace them.
explain.trap: 'utilità trascurabile' (little use) is wrong: belts are important in town too.

sceneParams.caption: Belts matter in town too

q24361.en: It is not compulsory to use seat belts in a car on trips shorter than one kilometre inside built-up areas.

explain.short: There is no minimum trip length. Even a very short drive in town needs the belt.
explain.rule: Seat belts (cinture di sicurezza) are compulsory for the driver and ALL passengers, front and rear, in every driving situation: in town, at low speed, on short trips. Airbags do not replace them.
explain.trap: 'inferiore a un chilometro' (shorter than 1 km): short trips are not exempt.

sceneParams.caption: Short trip in town: belt still compulsory

keywords.it: tragitti di lunghezza inferiore a un chilometro

q24362.en: Using seat belts allows children to be carried on the front seats in an adult's arms, without danger.

explain.short: A child in arms is crushed or thrown in a crash. Children must travel in their own approved restraint.
explain.rule: Children shorter than 1.50 m must travel in an approved child restraint (sistema di ritenuta) suited to their weight and height. Never without it, never in an adult's arms, on any road, at any speed.
explain.trap: 'in braccio a un adulto' (in an adult's arms) is never safe, belt or not.

sceneParams.caption: Never carry a child in your arms
lines: Not allowed: use a child seat

q24363.en: Children shorter than 1.50 metres, when carried in a car, must be held by approved restraint systems suited to their height and weight.

explain.short: A normal belt does not fit a small child. Below 1.50 m they need an approved child seat or booster.
explain.rule: Children shorter than 1.50 m must travel in an approved child restraint (sistema di ritenuta) suited to their weight and height. Never without it, never in an adult's arms, on any road, at any speed.
explain.trap: 'altezza inferiore a 1,50 metri' (under 1.50 m) is the correct limit; 'omologati' means approved.

sceneParams.caption: Under 1.50 m: approved child restraint

q24364.en: Children under 3 years of age may not travel in cars that do not have suitable restraint systems.

explain.short: A very small child cannot be protected by an adult belt. Without a suitable restraint they may not travel in that car.
explain.rule: Children shorter than 1.50 m must travel in an approved child restraint (sistema di ritenuta) suited to their weight and height. Never without it, never in an adult's arms, on any road, at any speed.
explain.trap: 'sprovviste' means 'without': a car with no suitable child restraint cannot carry a child under 3.

sceneParams.caption: Under 3: no child seat, no trip

q24366.en: If a car has an airbag, children can be carried on the front seat, secured in a suitable child seat, only if the vehicle has a control to switch off the airbag.

explain.short: An airbag opening against a child seat can badly hurt the child. So the front seat is allowed only when the airbag can be switched off.
explain.rule: A child seat facing backwards (back towards the windscreen) may go in the front seat ONLY if the passenger airbag is switched off. No switch to turn it off: never put that seat in the front.
explain.trap: 'solo se' (only if) is correct here: without a switch-off control the child seat goes in the back.

sceneParams.caption: Child seat in front only if the airbag can go off
lines: Then child seat in front is OK

q24366.reviewNote: The law forbids only rear-facing seats in front of an active airbag; the official answer generalises to all child seats.

q24367.en: Child restraint systems are classified in groups according to the weight of the child they can hold.

explain.short: Child seats come in groups for different weights, from babies to older children. Choose the group that fits your child.
explain.rule: Children shorter than 1.50 m must travel in an approved child restraint (sistema di ritenuta) suited to their weight and height. Never without it, never in an adult's arms, on any road, at any speed.
explain.trap: 'in gruppi, in funzione del peso' means 'in groups by weight': different seats for different sizes.

sceneParams.caption: Child seats come in groups by weight

q24368.en: Child restraint systems must be of an approved type and always kept in working order.

explain.short: Only approved child seats are tested to protect a child in a crash. They must always work properly.
explain.rule: Children shorter than 1.50 m must travel in an approved child restraint (sistema di ritenuta) suited to their weight and height. Never without it, never in an adult's arms, on any road, at any speed.
explain.trap: 'omologato' means 'officially approved'; 'efficienti' means 'in working order'.

sceneParams.caption: Child seats: approved and always working

q24369.en: Child restraint systems are of one single type and can all be used to carry children up to 1.50 metres tall.

explain.short: There are different groups of child seats for different weights. One seat does not fit every child.
explain.rule: Children shorter than 1.50 m must travel in an approved child restraint (sistema di ritenuta) suited to their weight and height. Never without it, never in an adult's arms, on any road, at any speed.
explain.trap: 'di un unico tipo' (of one single type) is wrong: there are several groups.

sceneParams.caption: Many types of child seat, not one for all

q24370.en: Carrying children without securing them to restraint systems is allowed, as long as it is on town roads.

explain.short: Children must always be secured in an approved restraint. Town roads are not an exception.
explain.rule: Children shorter than 1.50 m must travel in an approved child restraint (sistema di ritenuta) suited to their weight and height. Never without it, never in an adult's arms, on any road, at any speed.
explain.trap: 'purché su percorsi urbani' (as long as in town) is the trap: town gives no exception.

sceneParams.caption: In town too: child always in a restraint

q24371.en: Carrying children without securing them to restraint systems is allowed, as long as you drive at a maximum of 40 km/h.

explain.short: Children must always be secured in an approved restraint. A low speed is not an exception.
explain.rule: Children shorter than 1.50 m must travel in an approved child restraint (sistema di ritenuta) suited to their weight and height. Never without it, never in an adult's arms, on any road, at any speed.
explain.trap: 'purché ... 40 km/h' (as long as at most 40 km/h) is the trap: no speed makes it safe.

sceneParams.caption: Slow or fast: child always in a restraint

q24372.en: Carrying children without securing them to restraint systems is allowed, as long as they are on the front seats within the driver's reach.

explain.short: Children must always be secured in an approved restraint. Being within the driver's reach does not protect a child in a crash.
explain.rule: Children shorter than 1.50 m must travel in an approved child restraint (sistema di ritenuta) suited to their weight and height. Never without it, never in an adult's arms, on any road, at any speed.
explain.trap: 'a portata di braccio del conducente' (within the driver's reach): a driver cannot hold a child in a crash.

sceneParams.caption: Driver's arm can't hold a child in a crash

q24373.en: Carrying children without securing them to restraint systems is allowed, as long as they are on the front seats in the arms of an adult.

explain.short: Children must always be secured in an approved restraint. In an adult's arms a child is crushed or thrown in a crash.
explain.rule: Children shorter than 1.50 m must travel in an approved child restraint (sistema di ritenuta) suited to their weight and height. Never without it, never in an adult's arms, on any road, at any speed.
explain.trap: 'in braccio a persona maggiorenne' (in an adult's arms) is never safe for a child.

sceneParams.caption: Never carry a child in your arms

q24374.en: You may use seat belts instead of restraint systems to carry a child, as long as the child is taller than 1.30 metres.

explain.short: The limit is 1.50 m, not 1.30 m. Below 1.50 m a child needs an approved restraint, such as a booster seat.
explain.rule: Children shorter than 1.50 m must travel in an approved child restraint (sistema di ritenuta) suited to their weight and height. Never without it, never in an adult's arms, on any road, at any speed.
explain.trap: '1,30 metri' is the trap: the real limit is 1.50 m.

sceneParams.caption: Below 1.50 m (not 1.30): child restraint needed

keywords.it: al posto dei sistemi di ritenuta

q24375.en: Child seats may also be home-made, as long as they are approved by an expert from the local health authority (ASL).

explain.short: Child seats must be of an officially approved type (omologato), made and tested by the maker. A home-made seat is never allowed.
explain.rule: Children shorter than 1.50 m must travel in an approved child restraint (sistema di ritenuta) suited to their weight and height. Never without it, never in an adult's arms, on any road, at any speed.
explain.trap: 'costruzione artigianale' (home-made) is the trap: only officially approved seats are allowed.

sceneParams.caption: Only approved child seats, never home-made

q24376.en: The airbag is an inflatable cushion made of nylon or another synthetic material.

explain.short: That is what an airbag is: a cushion of strong fabric that fills with gas in a crash.
explain.rule: The airbag is a nylon cushion that a sensor inflates by itself in a few milliseconds in a violent crash. It works TOGETHER with the seat belt, never instead of it.
explain.trap: 'cuscino gonfiabile' means 'inflatable cushion'.

sceneParams.caption: Airbag = inflatable nylon cushion

q24377.en: The airbag goes off in a road accident with a violent impact.

explain.short: The airbag opens only in a strong crash, not in small bumps.
explain.rule: The airbag is a nylon cushion that a sensor inflates by itself in a few milliseconds in a violent crash. It works TOGETHER with the seat belt, never instead of it.
explain.trap: 'urto violento' (violent impact): only a strong crash makes it open.

sceneParams.caption: Airbag opens in a violent crash

q24378.en: The airbag can be dangerous if it goes off while you are not wearing the seat belt.

explain.short: Without a belt your body flies forward into the opening airbag, which hits you very hard.
explain.rule: The airbag is a nylon cushion that a sensor inflates by itself in a few milliseconds in a violent crash. It works TOGETHER with the seat belt, never instead of it.
explain.trap: 'pericoloso' (dangerous) is right: airbag without belt can injure you.

sceneParams.caption: Airbag without a belt can hurt you

keywords.en: you are not wearing the belt

q24379.en: The airbag serves to limit injuries to the vehicle's occupants from hitting inside surfaces of the vehicle in a violent impact after an accident.

explain.short: The airbag puts a soft cushion between you and the wheel or dashboard, so you get hurt less.
explain.rule: The airbag is a nylon cushion that a sensor inflates by itself in a few milliseconds in a violent crash. It works TOGETHER with the seat belt, never instead of it.
explain.trap: 'superfici interne' (inside surfaces) like the wheel and dashboard: the airbag protects you from them.

sceneParams.caption: Airbag cushions you from the wheel and dashboard

q24380.en: The airbag can sometimes be switched off.

explain.short: Some cars have a switch to turn off the passenger airbag, for example to fit a rear-facing child seat.
explain.rule: The airbag is a nylon cushion that a sensor inflates by itself in a few milliseconds in a violent crash. It works TOGETHER with the seat belt, never instead of it.
explain.trap: 'talvolta' (sometimes) is correct: not all airbags can be switched off, but some can.

sceneParams.caption: Some airbags can be switched off

q24381.en: The airbag inflates automatically, triggered by a sensor.

explain.short: A sensor feels the crash and inflates the airbag by itself. Nobody has to press anything.
explain.rule: The airbag is a nylon cushion that a sensor inflates by itself in a few milliseconds in a violent crash. It works TOGETHER with the seat belt, never instead of it.
explain.trap: 'automaticamente' (automatically) is right: the sensor, not the driver, starts it.

sceneParams.caption: A sensor inflates the airbag by itself

q24382.en: The airbag inflates in a few milliseconds.

explain.short: A crash happens very fast, so the airbag must open in a few thousandths of a second.
explain.rule: The airbag is a nylon cushion that a sensor inflates by itself in a few milliseconds in a violent crash. It works TOGETHER with the seat belt, never instead of it.
explain.trap: 'millisecondi' means 'thousandths of a second': much faster than seconds.

sceneParams.caption: Airbag inflates in milliseconds

q24383.en: The airbag inflates in a few seconds.

explain.short: A few seconds would be far too late: the crash is already over. The airbag inflates in a few milliseconds.
explain.rule: The airbag is a nylon cushion that a sensor inflates by itself in a few milliseconds in a violent crash. It works TOGETHER with the seat belt, never instead of it.
explain.trap: 'secondi' (seconds) vs 'millisecondi' (milliseconds): it is milliseconds.

sceneParams.caption: Milliseconds, not seconds

q24384.en: The airbag inflates when you press a button on the dashboard.

explain.short: There is no button to inflate the airbag. A crash sensor does it automatically.
explain.rule: The airbag is a nylon cushion that a sensor inflates by itself in a few milliseconds in a violent crash. It works TOGETHER with the seat belt, never instead of it.
explain.trap: 'premendo un pulsante' (pressing a button) is wrong: it is automatic.

sceneParams.caption: No button: a sensor inflates the airbag

q24385.en: The airbag must be inflated regularly to check that it works.

explain.short: An airbag inflates only once, in a crash. You never inflate it to test it.
explain.rule: The airbag is a nylon cushion that a sensor inflates by itself in a few milliseconds in a violent crash. It works TOGETHER with the seat belt, never instead of it.
explain.trap: 'gonfiato periodicamente' (inflated regularly) is wrong: it opens only in a crash.

sceneParams.caption: Never inflate an airbag to test it

q24386.en: The airbag is only useful on roads outside towns.

explain.short: Crashes happen everywhere, in town too. The airbag protects you on every road.
explain.rule: The airbag is a nylon cushion that a sensor inflates by itself in a few milliseconds in a violent crash. It works TOGETHER with the seat belt, never instead of it.
explain.trap: 'soltanto' (only) is the trap: the airbag works on all roads.

sceneParams.caption: Airbag useful on every road

q24387.en: The airbag must not be used together with seat belts.

explain.short: It is the opposite: the airbag is designed to work WITH the belt. Without the belt it can even hurt you.
explain.rule: The airbag is a nylon cushion that a sensor inflates by itself in a few milliseconds in a violent crash. It works TOGETHER with the seat belt, never instead of it.
explain.trap: 'non va usato insieme' (must not be used together) is wrong: belt and airbag go together.

sceneParams.caption: Airbag and belt work together

q24388.en: The airbag cannot be fitted on cars with fewer than 4 doors.

explain.short: The number of doors has nothing to do with airbags. Cars with 2 or 3 doors have airbags too.
explain.rule: The airbag is a nylon cushion that a sensor inflates by itself in a few milliseconds in a violent crash. It works TOGETHER with the seat belt, never instead of it.
explain.trap: 'meno di 4 porte' (fewer than 4 doors) is a made-up limit.

sceneParams.caption: Doors don't matter: any car can have airbags

q24389.en: The driver can set, with a special control, the minimum impact speed above which the airbag goes off.

explain.short: The airbag sensor is set by the maker. The driver cannot change when it goes off.
explain.rule: The airbag is a nylon cushion that a sensor inflates by itself in a few milliseconds in a violent crash. It works TOGETHER with the seat belt, never instead of it.
explain.trap: 'il conducente può tarare' (the driver can set) is wrong: there is no such control.

sceneParams.caption: Driver can't set when the airbag opens
lines: Opens by itself in a crash
